steps.text: Early morning
Rhodes Island Dormitories
Perfumer's Dormitory

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: (That should make for enough space.)

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: (For the output...)

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: (I'll probably need to tweak the cultivation method for this section.)

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: (And then here...)
Miss Lena, I've got reports for you!

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Hmm? Is that Podenco? Come right in.

steps.name: Podenco
steps.text: Good morning, Miss Lena.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Good morning, Podenco.

steps.name: Podenco
steps.text: Here's the inventory list you wanted, and the completed order form.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: (Inventory figures all seem to line up.)

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: (Order information is crystal clear, too, and the budget attached... seems alright.)

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: (There's a problem or two in plain sight, though. I wonder if she'll notice.)

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: You've done very well, handling all this documenting all by yourself.

steps.name: Podenco
steps.text: It feels very simple to do, compared to caring for the plants.

steps.name: Podenco
steps.text: Only...

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: (She noticed?)

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Mmm... it caught my eye.

steps.name: Podenco
steps.text: Orders and appointments, more and more are coming in lately... A little extra work's okay, and I can cope if I sleep a bit later, but..

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: We just don't have enough raw material.

steps.name: Podenco
steps.text: Right, the Garden flora's output can't keep up anymore.

steps.name: Podenco
steps.text: If we keep burning through them our current rate, we'll be out of fresh flowers to make things in a month.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Mm-hmm.

steps.name: Podenco
steps.text: If we can, I'd like to apply to purchase a few plants. That way, we can buy ourselves a little time while we think of a solution.

steps.name: Podenco
steps.text: Do you think that would be okay, Miss?

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Hmm. What to do?

steps.name: Podenco
steps.text: Miss, why are you still so calm? The flowers are going to run out, aren't they?!

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Heheh, don't worry. We'll find a way.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Here, come sit. Have a cup of tea, and take a breather.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: It just so happens I have a few questions I'd like your opinion on.

steps.name: Podenco
steps.text: Oh, if you really say so, Miss...

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Let me ask. With Rhodes Island roving all over Terra year-round, do you have a stable supplier to sell to you?

steps.name: Podenco
steps.text: If you leave it in Logistics's hands, they can probably work something out.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: But we can't trouble them with everything. There's always more important things for them to eke out channels and spend their funds on, isn't that right?

steps.name: Podenco
steps.text: Oh...

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: If the Logistics Department's Operators made contact with a supplier, but the other side couldn't meet our requirements, what then?

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: You have to consider, we painstakingly assembled the Garden's plantlife from across Terra. A certain few of our plants are even special kinds not permitted to be bought or sold.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: If we made an order, but they had no way of fulfilling our needs, what then?

steps.name: Podenco
steps.text: Then maybe we can purchase the more common ones, free up some space, and plant all rare flowers?

steps.name: Podenco
steps.text: Like the rugosa roses, maybe? What do you think?

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: (Pfft. There's a silly idea I had as well.)

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: You're right, they're the flower we use the most of, and the easiest to purchase at that.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Podenco, do you still remember the roses you planted where you grew up?

steps.name: Podenco
steps.text: Mm-hm!

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Then do you feel any particular difference between the roses back home, and the ones in the Garden?

steps.name: Podenco
steps.text: The rugosas back home had a lighter kind of aroma. It was less of a flower and more like one of our local fruits, really.

steps.name: Podenco
steps.text: The ones here have a much stronger fragrance, but they don't make your nose wrinkle either. They're really nice-smelling, Miss.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: See, both are rugosa roses all the same, yet they're so different. How could we make sure flowers from a supplier have the same qualities as the ones we grow here?

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: We could certainly treat those flowers like our own in use, but in the off-chance an Operator feels unwell using our goods because of that minute change in ingredients, I would be betraying the Doctor's trust.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Not to mention, despite being roses, some varieties aren't easy to purchase.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Do you still remember the ones growing in the freezer compartment?

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: They might be roses still, but their nature, and their medicinal nature above all, is very different from roses growing on the farms. Because they only grow in the northern tundras of Ursus, and the Medical Department specially entrusted me with their cultivation.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: I could never just freeze any rose I fancied and hand it over to Dr. Kal'tsit, could I?

steps.name: Podenco
steps.text: I'm sorry, Miss, I didn't think about any of this...

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Oh, it's quite alright.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: You've thought through a great deal already. You should be proud.

steps.name: Podenco
steps.text: Miss Lena, the way it sounds, you must have a plan. You can tell me.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: What to do indeed~

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Well, then, let's shutter the Convalescent Garden.

steps.name: Podenco
steps.text: Huh?!

steps.name: Podenco
steps.text: Miss Lena, you can't even consider closing down!

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: I've had a clear mind about it the entire time.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Lean in here a little, take a look at this.

steps.name: Podenco
steps.text: This is—?

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: The Convalescent Garden remodeling plan.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: I've already discussed it with the Doctor, who's agreed to clear the neighboring storehouse and incorporate it into the Garden entirely.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: This way, we can have more space for planting, provide an area for guests to relax, set up a dedicated aromatherapy room, and your little greenhouse can even get a fix-up alongside.

steps.name: Podenco
steps.text: Can I expand mine too?!

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Podenco
steps.text: That's wonderful!

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Moreover, I'm preparing to move my own dormitory in there.

steps.name: Podenco
steps.text: You're going to live in the Garden?

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: It takes too much time to get there from the dormitories, after all. So I thought to myself, I might as well just live there. Part of the research room will be merged with my own room.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: This way, I can actually save on quite a bit of space.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: The thing is—

steps.name: Podenco
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: The workload will be a bit too much, for just us two alone.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: It just so happens we'll have much more space to build an even larger greenhouse. Could I trouble you to find an Operator for the task, and bring them over for me?

steps.name: Podenco
steps.text: We'll need someone good with botany and greenhouse construction, right?

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Right.

steps.name: Podenco
steps.text: Then I'll go and find someone now. When I do, I'll get in touch with you, Miss.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Mmm, take care on your way.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Hm-hmm, she's grown a little more every day I see her.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Perhaps this time, I'll be able to just sit back and supervise?

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Really, that Miss Kal'tsit. I grumble to her and mention the poor plant quality, and she hands the whole Convalescent Garden straight off onto my back.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Planning, measuring, cultivation, every last little thing, left for me to sort out on my own...

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: And I, *sigh*... did exactly as she told, learning as I set things up...

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: At least I could grow some flowers, and give something or other to all of Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: And now...

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Hmm, now I can have Podenco build some strength too.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: I'll just get everything set up, sit on the sidelines, and give myself a little holiday of sorts.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Phew... ha...

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Let's have some tea and rest...

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Tea bags... tea bags...
Midday
Rhodes Island Dormitories
Perfumer's Dormitory

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: (This area shouldn't need any more alterations.)

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: (I'm a little peckish now.)

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: I wonder what to eat today?

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: I'm even hallucinating the smell of food.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Hmm?

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Hold on, is this—?

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: (*sniff* *sniff*)

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: How come I've never smelt any flower like this aboard the Island before?
Just gimme a liiiiittle bit, just a tiny patch, and things'll be gold.
All my little Metal Crabs are starting to grow up, and the new generation's gonna come into the world pretty soon too, so, for the sake of new life, hand me some space and you'll be a winner.
If I don't have enough farm room, I'll raise them in the dorms, seriously. I mean, they're not gonna cause a ruckus, but I don't think all the nice Misses living there are gonna be happy.
Augh, can't you just be a little flexible?! Ugh, I'm done with you. I'll find someone else!

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: You seem to be dealing with something or other. Is there anything I can help with?
Ah, afternoon. You're—?

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: I'm Lena, the Perfumer. I'm responsible for managing the Convalescent Garden and tending to the plants.

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: Nice to meet you, Lena. I'm Beanstalk.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: It's about lunchtime right now. If it's convenient for you, perhaps we can eat together? We can chat over our food that way.

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: Huh, really? It just so happens I'm a little hungry too.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: So, you specialize in Metal Crab farming, is that right?

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: Yep. They're all my sweet little darlings.

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: They're not like those wild Metal Crabs. They're tame and obedient. Some of them love people more than anything.

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: Like little Pea here.

steps.name: Peacake
steps.text: (Blinks)

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: May I—pet it?

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: Go right ahead. Pea's not scared of strangers.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: (It's not aggressive one bit. Well, then.)

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: (And the fragrance is definitely coming from the flowers on top of its head.)

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: (I've never scented this before. Perhaps it's an uncommon plant species?)

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: (It's not heavy, but it has staying power, and its aroma is very stable too.)

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: (It might not be bad as a base fragrance.)

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: (As for medicinal value, that'd have to wait until harvesting and further analysis.)

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: What'cha frozen there for, Miss Lena? What's on your mind?

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Ah, I'm very sorry about that. Just a bout of occupational disease.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Pea's scent is very pleasant, I have to say.

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: Really? Thank you, that's an amazing opinion to get from an expert!

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: If I might be so bold to ask, would I be allowed to pick the flower on Pea's head?

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: Go right on.

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: They snip them off each other or eat them when they're all playing together, you know, but they grow back real fast.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: (Is it a stable, symbiotic sort of plant? How interesting.)

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: (Perhaps I could ask and see if Beanstalk would help me 'plant' some?)

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: (I've been wanting to keep a few docile animals in the Garden, but just couldn't ever find a suitable breed.)

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: (This might just be my chance.)

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Well, then. Could you hear out a request of mine?

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: I'm all ears.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: I'm actually awfully interested in the plants on these little friends' heads.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: These flowers are exceptionally unique. This is my first time ever seeing them.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: If we worked on a specific application for them, I can guarantee they'd be very precious as a material.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: I just so happened to overhear your chat with the Logistics Operator. You're worrying over cultivation space as well, aren't you?

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: I'm thinking I could give you some room to settle your little friends down in.

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: For real?!

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: For real, indeed. If this works out, I can only presume everyone will reap the rewards.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: As long as these little ones are kept and raised well, and they don't scamper all about in the greenhouse.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: At appropriate times, they'd interact with Operators coming to the Garden too.

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: They're all personally raised by me, and they're not hostile with people. You've got no worries.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Thank you for your guarantee. It's a great reassurance.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: As for a contract, I'll leave drawing that up to you, if that's fine. We can talk over any associated expenditures and costs when the time comes.
*Bzzzzzt*—

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: I'm sorry, that's my terminal.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Mhmm, it's me.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: You've found somebody? Good, that's wonderful. Thank you so much.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: I'll come over right now.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Alright. See you in a moment.
*Bzzzt*

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Apologies, Beanstalk, but there's a thing or two that needs me. I'll be heading off first.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: This is my card. If you have the contract ready, you can contact me whenever.

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: Sounds good, Lena.

steps.name: Beanstalk
steps.text: Thanks a million! You're a real good one, you know!

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: You can find good ones anywhere. You'll only find someone as caring and sisterly as me right here!

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: See you later~
Rhodes Island Landship
Outside the Convalescent Garden

steps.name: Podenco
steps.text: Miss, I'm over here!

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Podenco, where's your Operator?

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Why do I only see—a small tractor?

steps.name: Podenco
steps.text: Bagpipe's behind it. She'll come over just in a moment.

steps.name: Podenco
steps.text: Bagpipe, Bagpipe!

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Ah! There you are!

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Been a long time, Perfumer!

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: I brought some soil over here for Podenco.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Already got all the ratios set up like you'd best want 'em. I can kick things off whenever, just waitin' for you to open up the door.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Gave some of it a grindin' down after I noticed the grain was a bit too coarse, so now that should make it easier some to mix.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: (She ground down—volcanic rock?)

steps.name: Podenco
steps.text: Miss Lena, what's wrong? You look a little pale. Do you feel unwell, maybe?

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Bagpipe, could I bother you just a second?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Aye, go ahead. I'll help however as long as I can.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Then I'd like you, please, to take the soil you mixed and separate it.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: You've. Mixed. It. Wrong.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: So sorry! I'm sorry! I thought you were mixin' the soil for flowers before you scattered it around the big shed!

steps.name: Podenco
steps.text: Miss, please don't be upset—I—I wasn't aware as well, I'm terribly sorry!

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Ha...

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: (Oh, so be it. I can't blame them. After all, I've done much stupider things...)

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: (I did once take an engineering vehicle and floor it all the way until I bumped into the cafeteria...)

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: (So this is Bagpipe. She's very familiar with agriculture, that's true. She should be able to help out.)

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: (Let's ask her to.)

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: (After I'm done with a few choice angry words.)

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Bagpipe, please, next time, never pull this sort of practical joke again.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Oh, I wasn't...

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Growing flowers in the Garden and growing vegetables in plots are very unalike. We're not trying to plant bulk monocultures in a finite space here, please understand that.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Um, ohh... got it...

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: We can't plant flowers in this soil now. Let's just use it for the farm's base layer when the time comes.

steps.name: Podenco
steps.text: The farm?

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Mmm, we're amending our refurbishment plans a little, since I'd like to raise some of Beanstalk's little Metal Crabs. We can go over it in more detail once we head back.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: If you don't need me, I'll just be headin' home now...

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Mhmm, that's fine. Drive the tractor away first.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Got it...

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: After all, we haven't even started today, so we won't need it.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Store the mixed soil at your place, since for now we don't have anywhere to dump it.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Alright...

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Once you're done, come drop by my dormitory room. There's still plenty I'll need to trouble you with.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Oh...

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Eh?

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: What's wrong?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Can I still, y'know, help out?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: You're not cross with me?

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: I am cross. Of course I'm cross.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: But even if I'm cross, we still have to get things done.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Or are you saying you're not ready to help us?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Course I am!

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Awww, bless you, Nena, you're a sweetheart!

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: If you wouldn't mind, please call me Lena...

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: I think Nena sounds a little cuter, though.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: We've still got plenty of work to do today, so let's head back for now, Podenco.

steps.name: Podenco
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: And move fast, Bagpipe. There's still a good deal of that work I need to entrust you with.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Don't try and dodge the subject.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: I see how it is, alright! I'll be right there!
Rhodes Island Dormitories
Perfumer's Dormitory

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: I'll leave planning the refurbished area to you. We might have more room to grow our plants, but we'll still want to save as much space as we can.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: We'll hand this section over to Beanstalk for farm use. I'll leave regularly picking those symbiotic flowers of theirs up to you too.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: And the section along the side—that'll be my new residence, then.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: The leftover materials from building the greenhouse will be enough for me. There'll be no need to procure anything special.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: That's the rough state of things.

steps.name: Podenco
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Nena, I'm here!

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Come in...

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: I've got everythin' all prepared already. Tell me just what you need me for!

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: I'd like to leave all the definitive build details tasked to you.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Gettin' your big shed set up? I'm no stranger to that.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: I'll also need you to help get in touch with Rhodes Island's construction team.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Even less of a problem. I know all the Operators in charge of repair works up by the agriculture area.

steps.name: Podenco
steps.text: Just leave it all to us, Miss Lena!

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: (If I could actually leave it all up to you two, that'd be marvelous...)

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: The Convalescent Garden will be closed while refurbishment is ongoing. I'll be responsible for growing and daily care of the plants in the original Garden, and providing continued aromatherapy to Operators who depend on it like Miss Pasbelletti.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Construction time is limited to a month. I think we should be able to complete refurbishments in around twenty-five days.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Podenco, could I ask you to repeat what tasks I just allocated to you?

steps.name: Podenco
steps.text: Right, Miss. I need to plan out the refurbished area, and make some room for your new dormitory and Beanstalk's farm.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Mhmm, and then?

steps.name: Podenco
steps.text: Then?

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: What material sheets to use, how to partition the plants, how to harvest Beanstalk's little Metal Crab flowers.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Have you considered any of those yet?

steps.name: Podenco
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: (It seems like she still hasn't decided.)

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: (I can't just toss her all alone into her work. I'll still need to give her some directions.)

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: (Our deadline's very tight this go round. We don't have any time for her to take things slowly.)

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: (A holiday... that'll have to wait after all.)

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Don't worry. Just in case, I was asking.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: I'll be in the Garden all throughout refurbishment, so if there's anything here or there you don't understand, you can come and ask me.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: I'll be moving my things over bit by bit from this dormitory, so it all works out.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: That should be more or less it. Do any of you have any questions?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: I always thought you only knew flowers, Nena, but you've got your head wrapped around so much.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: It takes doing these things yourself, before you understand how they should be done.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: So, you mean, way back then, everythin' in the Garden was all your work?

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Mhmm.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: There's always some things other people can't help with, things you can only really sort out yourself.

steps.name: Podenco
steps.text: I thought you would be the type to order other people to work, Miss.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: How would I order anyone without having personally done it before...

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Our every drop of sweat now is the experience we'll direct others with in the future. Do your best.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: I hope you'll learn successfully enough, and set up your own independent work.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Ideally, even take on an apprentice.

steps.name: Podenco
steps.text: Miss, there's no way I could...

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: When we have new Operators assigned to the Garden in future, you'll be their senior, and come that time, it'll be your responsibility to teach them.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Then I'll truly be able to leave the work to you, and I can sit back and give orders~

steps.name: Podenco
steps.text: Miss Lena~~

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: For now, just answer those few questions for me, okay?

steps.name: Podenco
steps.text: Ahh—

steps.name: Podenco
steps.text: Er, um, just let me think a little more...

steps.name: Podenco
steps.text: Miss~

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Some problems you just need to figure out yourself, you know.

steps.name: Podenco
steps.text: Aww...
